releaseNotes:
• Lightning Fast <500ms Link Resolution: Fixed the polaris httpErrorPage false-flagging bug and updated regex extraction for escaped JSON video_url and EmbeddedMediaImage, eliminating 10-second Headless WebView stalls.
• Step-by-Step Diagnostic Telemetry: All resolution tiers now produce a structured StepTrace with exact millisecond timings and status logs, viewable directly in Settings -> View Diagnostic Logs.
• Auto-Capture vs. Manual Paste Fix: Expanded ClipboardReader to support 2026 Instagram share tokens (/share/r/, /share/p/, /share/, /s/, /tv/, instagr.am) and restored clipboard auto-download in MainActivity.
• Instant Author & Caption Metadata: Extracts creator username and captions directly from embed payloads with 0ms delay.
• Dynamic Accessibility Watchdog: Real-time status subtitles and visual indicators for HEALTHY, ZOMBIE_UNBOUND, and DISABLED_BY_USER states.
